notes.title: Update 1.20 : improved graphics
notes.content:
Hello,

A new update was released today, with a lot of changes in the graphics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713749/e402f80cc0df0d60d4ffb7eb33ed586cbfbac860.jpg[/img]

[h1]More detail[/h1]

Every block has been reworked with more detailed, less repeating textures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713749/e204ec435dbac1bc370820a057b4faf258889ef6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Higher render distance[/h1]

In "High Quality" setting, you'll now have an overview of what's very far in the world: you can see trees and points of interest from a high distance.

This also reduce the way trees and structures were popping from nowhere when you move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713749/d6a30af15936ae87c7d717b72fca7b0058a3a2b0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Better quality[/h1]

With an improved SSAO and new edge smoothing system, the "High Quality" setting is now even more different from "Normal Quality" than before.

This is the same scene, first in "Normal Quality":

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713749/c2b630bfae76b0ce0967849085deb55d4271117c.jpg[/img]

Then in "High Quality":

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713749/3490b3eae60a9e4491b20214cd27a82e8309de1e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]

- bug fixes
- new option to have a strictly fixed FOV (normally it zooms out a bit when moving)
- you can now spawn every tree species easily from the Creative Inventory


Because the graphical engine was updated a lot for this version, if you experience any problem, crash or performance issue with this new version, please let me know in the Steam discussions.

Thank you again for your support!

notes.title: Update 1.11 : XP system and more
notes.content:
Hello,

A new update was released today, bringing some new features suggested by the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713749/ba9e0c16ff8eb712c4b4b162a30e20676c073839.jpg[/img]

[h1]New XP and Level system[/h1]

When you beat a monster, discover a new place or complete a quest, you'll now gain some XP. If you get enough XP you'll level up, and each new level gives you 10% more health and 10% more stamina.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713749/0c8bcec6650304776c6f8ce1d665c8c6e9c16542.jpg[/img]

[h1]Keep inventory on death[/h1]

This was suggested by several players through the community hub. When you die, you'll no longer have to go back to the place you died to pick up your inventory items. Now, the only thing you drop is 20% of your Metal and 10% of your Crystal. You keep everything else in your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11713749/25db3877b5747378c5e3dc8485d27fc554c0cd5d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Running no longer uses stamina[/h1]

You can now keep running without using your stamina. This should prevent you from running out of stamina when you need it to cast a fireball...
Because of this, the key bind which was used previously to run is now use to walk slowly, and default is now to run.

[h1]Misc[/h1]

Other changes include some bug fixes and Improved 3rd person view.


All these changes aim at making the game more fun to play according to user suggestions through the community forums. Please keep giving ideas and suggestions to make the game even better!

Thank you again for your support!

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Implementing ideas from the community
notes.content:
Hello,

A new version was released today, focusing on suggestions from players in the Steam discussions.

[h1]Houses and loot[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/ae9ddf3643f3b3c8e9862d407dc31f7f0f6af96e.jpg[/img]

A wider variety of house can now be encountered in the world and villages, and they now contain chests with randomized loot.

Note: only regions you didn't visit already before can contain the new varied loot and houses.

[h1]Portals[/h1]

If you have created more than 2 portals, going through a portal will ask you which portal you want to teleport to.

Use the rename option of the portal to know where you are heading!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/2d3035e6db37d9d0f09659be0af1eaf13dd8e906.jpg[/img]

Note: this only works in singleplayer right now.

[h1]Inventory[/h1]

- when you add an item/craft to your hotbar which was already full, it will replace the last one instead of shifting all the elements of your hotbar

- dropping an item to the ground with right click is now made clear by a message

[h1]Misc[/h1]

- to toggle the Flying Wind to Creative Wind, you now need to hit space twice or use the key bind you chose in Controls. This is to reduce the accidental toggle to Creative Wind.

- when you invite a friend to your world, he now shares permissions with you by default, use Tab to remove permissions

- the compass now shows markers more or less transparently in relation to the distance, while the custom marker is always shown clearly.

- beds now display a short transition to toggle day time

- it's no longer possible to /ban yourself accidently
- increased the size of Golems hitbox
- fixed a bug which leaded to see fireballs stuck in the air
- various bug fixes

Thank again for your feedback in the Steam discussions!

notes.title: Update 1.0d: new use for Wind and more
notes.content:
Hello,

A patch was released today, focusing on suggestions from players in the Steam discussions.

[h1]Wind[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/bb1b7c986e290dc5e02c7a4a2dcf36f611e68fe1.jpg[/img]

When you have the Flying Wind element in hand, press space to slowly levitate in the middle of the air, while being able to change the block in your hand to build something high or big.

Press Space to go up or Shift to go down.

To disable this type of flight, press space twice or take the wind element in hand and left click.
Note: you can't use attacks while levitating.
 
This type of flight uses less wind resources when you don't move.

[h1]Items on display[/h1]

You can now break item frames or altar containing a sword or an orb and the item won't get destroyed as before, instead it will fall and you are able to pick it up.

[h1]New video settings options[/h1]

The sun now is less glaring when you look in its direction.
In addition to that, two new videos settings options can be changed when you are in High quality:
- sun-shafts
- SSAO

[h1]Misc.[/h1]

- when you break a chest, a oven or anything created with the "Transform into Object" tool, you can pick up some of the material you used to build it.
- these objects are now a bit quicker to break without a tool

- fixed a bug which made that when you give life to several creatures, their armor and strength could be the same (and abnormally weak) instead of depending on the material you use to build the creature.
- fixed a bug when you give life to creatures the close and reopen the game later, their armor and strength could be abnormally weak.

- fixed some bugs with AI
- various bug fixes

Thank again for your feedback in the Steam discussions!

notes.title: Version 1.0 Release Information
notes.content:
Version 1.0 of Alchemist's Awekening is now available!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/50ebef9b73e8cbb7819d389224b82cf5b0f38e1b.jpg[/img]

We appreciate your support and love for Alchemist's Awekening since the first alpha versions. 
After a few months of development, Version 1.0 is here today and it comes with a lot of exciting features!

If you already tried an older version of the game, please [b]create a new world to experience all the new features.[/b] Also, because of some changes in the world generation with 1.0 release, the official server map was reset.

[h1]Play with your friends[/h1]

Playing in survival or creative co-op mode is easier than ever, simply use the "Invite friends" button while in a world or the "Join you friends" button to play with your Steam friends: online servers are no longer the only way to play with other people, you can invite your friends to every world you create.
This also fully support worlds with custom items found on the Workshop or created by you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/d3c640f0fb1f3d62ba1780b7bea8c62804cffcee.jpg[/img]

Online servers still offer a way to create bigger communities, with a world which is always online and persisted in a dedicated server.

[h1]New map options[/h1]

It's now possible to add a marker in your map by right-clicking. This marker can be seen in the map, the compass, and by your friends in co-op mode.
Your friends can also see your position on the map if you choose the "Share permissions" with them. Use the Tab key to see the list of connected players and share permissions.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/ccccf1f01d4be2fbcfaabcc45296d4e508f794c4.jpg[/img]

[h1]New creatures[/h1]

Beware of some new hostiles and powerful creatures…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/572b4464fa4629ebe2864adccd67dd676e75ce06.jpg[/img]

[h1]Big Sand block and big Ice block[/h1]

Some Big Sand blocks and big Ice blocks can now be found in the world. Give life to a creature and it will be able to continuously mine Sand and Ice for you if you bring it near a Big Sand block or a big Ice block. This is also possible with Stone and Metal.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/ec752671788edc45e2b26b34e53ebb09cb2bc9e0.jpg[/img]

This allow for the automation of production of every base element with the exception of Crystal.

[h1]Unveil some mysteries[/h1]

There is more to discover. [b]Create a new world in survival mode[/b] and explore the world alone of with friends in co-op. Ask villagers for interesting places to visit.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/6f1f56be1d7f780a184066e1da985df0dd0c98d1.jpg[/img]


Finally, a huge amount of bug was fixed and a lot of optimization work done on the game. But if you encounter any bug, please report it using the Steam discussion forums.

We will continue to bring more content to Alchemist's Awekening for you to enjoy!

notes.title: 0.97 - Changes in UI and controls
notes.content:
Hello,

A new update was released today, improving the UI and controls, for a more intuitive gameplay.

[h1]Compass[/h1]
On top of the screen, you'll see some indication on the direction you're looking at, and points of interest which are also in your map.

[h1]Break and place blocks and items[/h1]
The new default controls for breaking and placing blocks have been changed:
- the first slot of the hotbar is now your empty hand. When it is selected, you can break blocks using Left or Right Click.
- when you have a block or item in your hand, press Left Click to place it, and Right Click to remove and collect a block.
- you can go back to the previous controls in the Controls menu where there is a "Mouse button to place a block" setting: if you change this, you'll need to press Right Click to place it, and Left Click to remove it just like before this update.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/c96ec689f604184179c4d74e17d038ee10b94795.jpg[/img]

[h1]"Transform into object" tool[/h1]
The "Make useful" tool is renamed "Transform into object" and now offers a preview of the result. You'll need to hold Left click for one second to transform a shape into an object. During this one second, you'll see a preview and will be able to cancel the action if the preview does not match your expected result.

[h1]"Gife life" power[/h1]
The "Gife life" power now has a preview of the blocks affected. You'll need to hold Left click for one second to give life to a shape. During this one second, you'll see which blocks will be part of the creature, and you will be able to cancel the action if you realise you're giving life to your entire house and not just a few blocks ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/4d80908b2298b96d15140359d28a7f59a2da1f3d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Inventory[/h1]
The hotbar as been improved in the inventory, with icons making it clear that you remove a item from the hotbar, and the possibility to swap item places in the hotbar.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/a7871e29313b579dd528b5c17705758f709ea4c8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Misc.[/h1]
- fixed a bug causing random teleportations, sharks flying in villages and other stange things
- several other bug fixes
- added more plains to the world generation
- you can now press Space twice in quick succession to toggle fly mode in creative mode

[h1]More to come![/h1]
More content is being added to the game, and couldn't be included in this update yet, but here is a spoiler screenshot.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/58151568ec6920be5af7a3152887170f667da762.jpg[/img]


Thanks again for your support! Please use the Steam discussion forums to report any bugs you might encounter.

notes.title: 0.95 - Pipes, Electric Systems, TNT and more
notes.content:
Hello,

A new update was released today, introducing a lot of new blocks!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/493189191ef7517e95ccc665d7ed8d8cf67c02b1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pipes[/h1]

Pipes are used to transfer some elements from a source device, such as a windmill, to a receiver such as a chest.

3 type of pipes can be crafted:
- Fire pipes, using Metal and Fire
- Wind pipes, using Metal and Wind
- Electricity pipes, using Metal and Electricity

You can use them on ovens, windmills, thunder rods, chests and some other items.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/57d5be29ceb91ead1a27d484b04f0fd97a586eed.jpg[/img]

[h1]Valves and Switches[/h1]

Valves can be put on Fire and Wind pipes to close the pipe. They can be activated by an electrical signal coming from an Electricity Pipe.

Switches can be put on Electricity pipes to close the pipe.

[h1]Buttons and Pressure Plates[/h1]

Buttons and pressure plates can be connected to Electricity Pipes and will produce some electrical impulses when used.

Craft them using electricity + metal.

notes.title: 0.86 - Create Adventure maps
notes.content:
Hi,

A new update was released today with a lot of interesting features for map makers.

Here is what you can do to create and share adventure maps:

[h1]Create custom blocks[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/4adbabdc5cabc6594fe27ad5b8b480229d76fafa.jpg[/img]

You can now create custom block which can be placed and broken exactly like normal blocks in the game.
They can contain a mixture of all elements including grass and glass, and can emit light.
Example here: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=774423466

[h1]Create custom mobs/NPC[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/28e10b3bd2450b6790f1136ae596a60469b4ad7b.jpg[/img]

It is now possible to create custom mobs, they are like the creature you can give life to, but you can script them to add dialogs and interact with quests.
Example here: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=774420868

[h1]Add quests to you maps[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/9f2782fda56989cb779d05d71413c71352ebc9dd.jpg[/img]

This version also comes with a first version of the quest editor. There are still some bugs at the moment.
I'll write a full guide on how to create quests later on.

[h1]Add waypoints to your maps[/h1]

There are some new commands to add waypoints without creating a portal.
You can use this tool to do that:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=774400649

[h1]Other changes[/h1]

In survival mode, some blocks such as crystal and rare metal can now only broken with tools and not by hand.

Quests are now available in multiplayer so you'll see the default building tutorial quest on the official server.

Thank you again for your support,
Marc

notes.title: Update 0.83 - More scripting options
notes.content:
Hello, 

A new update was released today, introducing a lot of new scripting options for custom items, weapons, and powers!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11713749/b27c9b201bf76250c3ed09bce3dbe7a1b2372598.jpg[/img]

Here is a summary of the new scripting features:

[h1]New Syntax:[/h1]
function <name>
   ...
end

if <condition> then
  ...
end

New accessors:
entity.blockx - entity.blocky - entity.blockz
entity.targetx - entity.targety - entity.targetz
entity.type
entity.typeid
entity.name

[h1]New Commands:[/h1]
[list]
     [*][b]call[/b] calls a function previously defined
     [*][b]spawnMob[/b] spawns a mob (wolf, thief...)
     [*][b]spawnItem[/b] spawns an item/weapon (chest, sword, custom item...)
     [*][b]placeBlock[/b] places a block of specified type in the world
     [*][b]removeBlock[/b] removes a block
     [*][b]spawnSchematic[/b] paste a building to the world
     [*][b]timer[/b] sets a timer to call a function after some time
     [*][b]raycast[/b] cast a ray to find the first block in the looking direction
     [*][b]display[/b] shows messages with custom style on screen
     [*]...
[/list] 

A full guide of all commands will be available soon here: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=703608909

[list]

Hello,

A new update was released today, introducing a new menu option, "Play with friends."
This allows you to invite your friends to play with you in any world you created, without the need to set up a dedicated server. Up to 4 friends can join you at a time.

This feature is still very experimental (and Windows only for the moment), please let us know if you experience any problem.

- lighting tweaks for more dynamic colors
- mobs can now loot resources
- a few bug fixes

Thanks you very much for you support!
